column1: # Panel event gelombang 7 — Beginner Procurement dan kluster
# [Procurement Description] (Custom Procurement - Armament).
# Varian Armament memakai istilah sendiri: "Armament" (bukan Weapon),
# "Extraction Vouchers", "Redundant Fragments", dan "pity system".
# "pity" dipertahankan karena itu istilah baku di komunitas gacha.
# Daftar nama Armament di sini TIDAK berkutip di sumbernya — dibawa backref.
# ============ Beginner Procurement ============
=The Beginner Procurement is exclusive for new Commanders.
column2: Beginner Procurement khusus untuk Komandan baru.

column1: =In this banner, you can enjoy a 20% discount for every 10 accesses.
column2: Di banner ini, kamu mendapat diskon 20% untuk tiap 10 access.

column1: =This interface will remain available until 50 accesses have been completed, after which, the Beginner Procurement interface will be closed.
column2: Antarmuka ini tersedia sampai 50 access selesai, setelah itu antarmuka Beginner Procurement akan ditutup.

column1: =-Elite Doll Drop Rate Details
column2: -Detail Drop Rate Elite Doll

column1: =-Detailed Rules
column2: -Aturan Rinci

column1: =In this banner, the base drop rate of obtaining an Elite Doll is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, with an overall drop rate (including guarantees) of <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.
column2: Di banner ini, drop rate dasar mendapat Elite Doll adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, dengan drop rate keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan) <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.

column1: =In this banner, the base drop rate of obtaining a Standard Doll or Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, with the base drop rate for Standard Dolls being <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>.
column2: Di banner ini, drop rate dasar mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, dengan drop rate dasar Standard Doll <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>.

column1: =The probability of obtaining a Standard Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas mendapat Standard Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>.

column1: =The overall drop rate (including guarantees) for both is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.
column2: Drop rate keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan) untuk keduanya adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.

column1: =In this banner, every 10 accesses guarantee either a Standard Doll, a Standard Weapon, or an Elite Doll.
column2: Di banner ini, tiap 10 access dijamin mendapat Standard Doll, Standard Weapon, atau Elite Doll.

column1: =If you haven't obtained an Elite Doll in 49 consecutive accesses, the 50th is guaranteed to be an Elite Doll.
column2: Kalau kamu belum mendapat Elite Doll dalam 49 access berturut-turut, access ke-50 dijamin Elite Doll.

column1: =If an Elite Doll is obtained before the 50th access, the 50th access will not guarantee an Elite Doll.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll sudah didapat sebelum access ke-50, access ke-50 tidak lagi menjamin Elite Doll.

column1: =The counter to a guaranteed item for this banner accumulates independently of other banners.
column2: Hitungan menuju item jaminan di banner ini terakumulasi terpisah dari banner lain.

column1: =In this banner, obtaining a Retired Weapon gives 2 Withdrawal Receipts.
column2: Di banner ini, mendapat Retired Weapon memberi 2 Withdrawal Receipts.

column1: =A Standard Doll or Weapon gives 12 Redundant Pieces; an Elite Doll or Weapon gives 60 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Standard Doll atau Weapon memberi 12 Redundant Pieces; Elite Doll atau Weapon memberi 60 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =When obtaining duplicate Standard Dolls, the 2nd through 7th acquisitions convert into 30 Neural Archives for the respective Doll; from the 8th acquisition onward, they convert into 18 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Saat mendapat Standard Doll ganda, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Archives untuk Doll terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 18 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =In this type of procurement, the base probability of obtaining an Elite Armament is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, and the overall probability (including the pity system guarantee) is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Elite Armament adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, dan probabilitas keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan sistem pity) adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.

column1: =In this type of procurement, the base probability for Standard Armaments is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, and the overall probability for Standard Armaments (including the pity system guarantee) is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, probabilitas dasar Standard Armament adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, dan probabilitas keseluruhan Standard Armament (termasuk jaminan sistem pity) adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>.

column1: =In this type of procurement, every 10 procurements guarantee at least a Standard or Elite Armament.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, tiap 10 procurement dijamin mendapat minimal Standard atau Elite Armament.

column1: =In this type of procurement, if no Elite Armament is obtained for 50 consecutive attempts, the probability of obtaining an Elite Armament on subsequent attempts will increase.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, kalau Elite Armament tidak didapat dalam 50 percobaan berturut-turut, probabilitas mendapatkannya pada percobaan berikutnya akan naik.

column1: =An Elite Armament is guaranteed within 70 procurements.
column2: Elite Armament dijamin didapat dalam 70 procurement.

column1: =Whenever an Elite Armament is obtained, the counter resets, and the probability of obtaining an Elite Armament returns to the base rate.
column2: Tiap kali Elite Armament didapat, hitungannya direset dan probabilitas mendapat Elite Armament kembali ke rate dasar.

column1: =If the Elite Armament obtained in this procurement is not the rate-up Elite Armament for this period, the next Elite Armament obtained is guaranteed to be the rate-up Elite Armament for this period.
column2: Kalau Elite Armament yang didapat di procurement ini bukan Elite Armament rate-up periode ini, Elite Armament berikutnya dipastikan yang rate-up periode ini.

column1: =The pity counter for this type of procurement does not carry over and is completely independent of the pity counters for other types of procurements; they do not affect each other.
column2: Hitungan pity tipe procurement ini tidak terbawa dan sepenuhnya terpisah dari hitungan pity tipe procurement lain; keduanya tidak saling memengaruhi.

column1: =In this type of procurement, each time an old-style weapon is obtained, 2 additional Extraction Vouchers are given.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, tiap kali senjata model lama didapat, diberikan tambahan 2 Extraction Vouchers.

column1: =Each time a Standard Doll or Armament is obtained, 12 additional Redundant Fragments are given.
column2: Tiap kali Standard Doll atau Armament didapat, diberikan tambahan 12 Redundant Fragments.

column1: =Each time an Elite Doll or Armament is obtained, 60 additional Redundant Fragments are given.
column2: Tiap kali Elite Doll atau Armament didapat, diberikan tambahan 60 Redundant Fragments.
